resources.string: The address must start with wss:// (or ws:// for a device on your own network).
Enter a valid server host name, for example wss://relay.example.com.
Do not put a user name or password in the address.
The port must be a number from 1 to 65535.
Plain ws:// is only allowed for localhost or a private network address. Use wss:// for other servers.
